add_comment.description: Add an internal comment to a conversation. Only teammates see it: it is never sent to the customer.

parameters.description: Pin it to the top of the conversation.

conversation_id.description: The conversation the comment was added to.

parameters.description: The conversation's Front id, which looks like cnv_55c8c149. Use 'List conversations' or 'Search conversations' to find one -- you can also paste the web address of the conversation from Front.
parameters.name: conversation_id

parameters.description: The reply body. HTML is supported on email channels.
parameters.name: body

parameters.description: A plain-text version of the body, for email clients that cannot show HTML.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: Override the subject line. Leave blank to keep the conversation's own.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: Override the recipients, as handles. Leave blank to reply to whoever is on the conversation.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Handles to copy in.
parameters.name: cc

parameters.description: Handles to copy in privately.
parameters.name: bcc

parameters.description: Send from a different channel. Leave blank to use the conversation's own.
